replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write down your equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. To find stationary points, take the derivative of f(x), which gives you f'(x). Then set f'(x) equal to zero and solve for x. These are your critical points. Plug each value back into the original function to get the corresponding y-values. These (x,y) pairs are your stationary points.
